title: U-Space: Decoding Where LLMs Hide Doubt

beats.text: Why do 50% of your GPU cycles waste compute before U-Space fixes the bottleneck?
beats.visual_focus: A glowing neural network node flickering between green and red.

visual_blueprint.title: THE CONFIDENCE PARADOX
visual_blueprint.sub: Why fluent output hides internal doubt

motif_params.title: THE CONFIDENCE PARADOX
motif_params.sub: Why fluent output hides internal doubt

beats.text: The villain is length bias. We confuse wordy, rambling explanations for deep reasoning, ignoring the model's actual internal confusion.
beats.visual_focus: A long, winding text stream collapsing into a single, shaky vector.

visual_blueprint.title: THE LENGTH TRAP
visual_blueprint.sub: Why word count is not intelligence

motif_params.title: THE LENGTH TRAP
motif_params.sub: Why word count is not intelligence

beats.text: Enter U-Space. We mapped internal vectors to a specific 'doubt' direction, isolating where the model's logic actually begins to drift.
beats.visual_focus: A 3D vector space rotating to reveal a distinct 'doubt' axis.

visual_blueprint.title: U-SPACE ARCHITECTURE
visual_blueprint.sub: A 3D vector space rotating to reveal a distinct 'doubt' axis.

beats.text: The U-Lens projects token states onto an orthogonal basis. It is a simple dot product measuring alignment with the doubt axis.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—I hate when models hallucinate with confidence, so you had me immediately. I like that you called out length bias because that's a real pain point when debugging model outputs. I got lost for a split second on 'orthogonal basis'—I know what it means in linear algebra, but it felt a bit like a flex rather than an explanation. Otherwise, it was clean and didn't sound like a corporate marketing bot.

thriller_metadata.physical_analogy: A rambling witness whose confidence is mistaken for truth because they speak in long, complex sentences.
